rows.note: Use this for being eligible or formally entitled to do a job or apply for a position.

example.english: They are qualified to apply for this job.
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau5 zi1 gaak3 san1 cing2 ni1 fan6 gung1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when someone meets the standard or has enough training for a job.

example.english: After three years, you are qualified for promotion to supervisor.
example.traditional: 你做咗三年，夠資格升做主管喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 zou6 zo2 saam1 nin4 gau3 zi1 gaak3 sing1 zou6 zyu2 gun2 laa3

rows.note: Use this when an agreement, approval, or view applies only subject to stated conditions.

example.english: This approval is qualified by the condition that we first submit all the documents.
example.traditional: 呢個批准係有條件嘅，要先交齊文件。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 pai1 zeon2 hai6 jau5 tiu4 gin6 ge3 jiu3 sin1 gaau1 cai4 man4 gin2

rows.note: Use this especially for an opinion or statement that is qualified by reservations rather than being fully definite.

example.english: I have some qualified reservations about whether this plan will succeed.
example.traditional: 我對呢個計劃可唔可以成功，仲有保留。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1 zung6 jau5 bou2 lau4
